title: cephaelis appendiculata
intro: Cephaelis appendiculata, commonly known as Wild Ipecac, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as the treatment of respiratory issues, fever reduction, and digestive aid. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis appendiculata include expectorant, emetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, primarily psychotrine and ipecac alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
